# 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다.
# [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQKoreaSpring2025#53733-spectator-limit)이 존재합니다.

### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다.
### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/62/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/62/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오.
### 주최측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인하시기 바랍니다.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.
원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___
# There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition.
# There is a [Spectator Limit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQKoreaSpring2025#53733-spectator-limit).

### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist.
### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/62/competitors). Please check the [waitlist](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/62/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list.
### Please be sure to check emails sent by the organizers.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with official WCA competitions.

items.name: Rock-Cube-Lin Qualifier 2025
items.information:
Get ready for another Rocklin competition!

### **Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.**

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/), [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/), and QiYi Toys.
